claims.text: The driver's own trace shows he held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous 429 seconds, from 19:58:47 to 20:05:56, which is longer than the 180-second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD-zone trip. On the face of the dwell arithmetic the waiting period was served.

The rider's device was never inside the 100 m rider-presence radius for this STANDARD zone: rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 out of 62 rider fixes, and the rider track's minimum distance from the pin is 884 m, with a mean of 888 m. The rider was not at the pickup point during the waiting window, so the driver's cancellation for a no-show was not premature.

The rider's own message at 20:01:07 says only 'coming down now' - it gives no entrance, block, tower or bay identifier and no position. It is not a locating or coordinating message within POL-NS-04(a), and in any event the driver had already messaged at 19:59:12 and the rider's reply came 115 seconds later, so the rider was the party out of contact, not the driver.

The arrival marker was not false. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 19:58:47 and the trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at the same 19:58:47, with a dwell start offset of 0.0 seconds; the driver's track shows a stationary speed of 0.0 kph during the dwell. There is no distance-over-300 m or speed-at-or-above-15 kph reading at the arrival timestamp, so POL-NS-05 does not displace the waiting clock.

The fare ledger reconciles: the cancellation-fee line is SGD 4.50, which equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd for this trip, and the ledger notes state the lines reconcile to total_charged. There is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect to discount the charge.

The driver's anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 0, which is below the threshold of 4, and 0 divided by completed_trips_30d (138) is 0.0, not greater than 0.08. Both limbs of the POL-NS-07 check must hold and neither does, so compensation is payable rather than withheld.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, and the driver's disputes_with_counterparty_90d is also 0. Neither the POL-NS-09(c) repeat-dispute trigger nor the POL-NS-09(d) abuse trigger is engaged, so there is no basis to escalate this case to human review.

The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING - no advisory covers this pickup in this window - and it carries weight 0.0. Because it is absent, POL-NS-06(i) cannot be run to accumulate dwell across intervals, and the driver does not assert it; the dwell here is a single continuous 429-second run in any event, so the missing advisory changes nothing.

The rider's claim that he was 'only a few minutes late' is contradicted by the record: the driver arrived at 19:58:47, the rider's first message came at 19:59:12, and the rider's own reply 'coming down now' was sent at 20:01:07 - more than two minutes after the driver's arrival message and after the free waiting period had already elapsed. The rider was not a few minutes late; he was not at the pickup point at all.

All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold: (a) the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 19:58:47; (b) the trace places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at that timestamp; (c) the driver held position for 429 seconds, exceeding the 180-second free waiting period; and (d) the trip was terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 20:06:00, after the dwell elapsed. The fee is therefore legitimately chargeable and the driver is entitled to compensation at 80 percent of SGD 4.50, being SGD 3.60.

claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous qualifying run of 429 seconds, from 19:58:47 to 20:05:56, which is well past the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip. POL-NS-01 limb (c) is therefore satisfied on the driver's own evidence.

The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 19:58:47 and a wait_timer_started event at 19:58:49, and the GPS trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at the same 19:58:47 timestamp, so limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is met: the driver was inside the geofence at or before the arrival event.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 20:06:00 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three reason codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, and the cancellation fell after the required dwell had elapsed. Limb (d) is satisfied.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: the driver's trace shows a distinct speed of 0.0 kph at the arrival moment and the qualifying run is stationary, so the marker was not tapped while the driver was still travelling at 15 km/h or more, and the driver was not more than 300 m from the pin. The waiting clock runs from the arrival event as recorded.

The rider's own track places her device at a minimum distance of 884 m from the pickup pin throughout the waiting window, with 62 fixes and a mean distance of 888 m, and zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider presence radius. She was not at the pickup point while the driver waited.

The chat log shows the driver messaged 'hi im at the pickup point, where are you' at 19:59:12, and the rider replied 'coming down now' at 20:01:07 - the rider's own words confirm she was not yet at the pickup point more than two minutes after the driver arrived, and the driver cancelled at 20:06:00, nearly five minutes after that reply.

The fare breakdown shows the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 was charged and the payment status is CHARGED with no refund issued, and the fee reconciles with the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50 in force for this trip, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect.

The driver is entitled to compensation at 80 percent of the cancellation fee under POL-NS-07, which is SGD 3.60 of the SGD 4.50 net figure, and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, well below the threshold of 4, and 0 divided by 138 completed trips is 0.0, well below 0.08.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, so neither the POL-NS-09(d) abuse trigger nor the POL-NS-09(c) repeat-dispute trigger is engaged, and the case does not require escalation on those grounds.

The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING - no advisory covers Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 in this window - so POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable and cannot be used to accumulate dwell across intervals. The driver does not need it: the single continuous qualifying run of 429 seconds already exceeds the 180 second minimum, so the shortfall computation returns -249 seconds and the fee is chargeable.

The rider's claim that she was 'only a few minutes late' is contradicted by her own GPS track, which shows her device stationary at approximately 884 m from the pickup pin for the entire waiting window, and by her chat message 'coming down now' sent at 20:01:07, more than two minutes after the driver arrived. The driver waited 429 seconds - more than seven minutes - before cancelling.

ruling.explanation:
Rider, the SGD 4.50 no-show charge stands, and the case produces a platform payment to the driver.

On the record, the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 19:58:47 on 5 September, and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02701, weight 1.0) independently places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at that same second — the first qualifying in-geofence fix is 19:58:47, dwell start offset 0.0 s — and holds him stationary there for a continuous 429 seconds to 20:05:56. That is longer than the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). The trip was then terminated by the driver at 20:06:00 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are therefore met and the fee of SGD 4.50 (platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, matching the fare_breakdown line of SGD 4.50) is legitimately chargeable.

Your own case is answered. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02701) shows the driver messaged 'hi im at the pickup point, where are you' at 19:59:12 and you replied only 'coming down now' at 20:01:07 — over two minutes after the driver arrived and with no entrance, block, tower or bay identified. Your rider track places your device about 884 m from the pin (mean 888 m, 0 qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius) throughout the waiting window. POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered) therefore does not apply: even if limb (a) were read in your favour, limb (c) fails affirmatively on admissible fixes, and so does not exonerate you. You were not 'only a few minutes late'.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: at the arrival second the driver's speed is 0.0 kph and he is well inside 300 m of the pin, so the recorded waiting clock stands. POL-NS-06 does not apply: the effective dwell of 429 s exceeds the 180 s minimum (shortfall -249 s), so no refund arises. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02701-01, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) is not relied on for anything — the dwell is a single continuous run, so no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is needed, and its absence is not the evidence for any deciding fact. No integrity defect under POL-NS-08 was found: arrival timestamps match, the trace has no sampling gap, the chat count reconciles with the trip record, and the fare line equals the fee in force. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is engaged.

Under POL-NS-07 the driver is compensated at 80 percent of the fee in force, SGD 3.60, and the anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 0, and 0 / 138 completed trips = 0.0). Because the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60 figure as driver_compensation_sgd; that is the amount this ruling moves, and your SGD 4.50 charge is left in place. The monetary effect (SGD 3.60) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes automatically; either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04. No clause produces a referral on these facts.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the disputed SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee stands, and the driver is owed SGD 3.60. RIDER: your claim that you were 'only a few minutes late' is not supported by the record. DRIVER: your arrival, dwell and cancellation are all confirmed, and your compensation is payable.

Why the fee stands. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 19:58:47, and the GPS trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at exactly that timestamp (dwell start offset 0.0 s), so the arrival marker is genuine and the waiting clock was not started early. The trace shows the driver holding position inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius for one continuous, qualifying 429-second run, from 19:58:47 to 20:05:56 — well beyond the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec; there is no longer no_show_threshold_sec set). The trip was then terminated by the driver at 20:06:00 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, and after the required dwell had elapsed. All four conditions of POL-NS-01 therefore hold: (a) an 'arrived' event exists; (b) the trace places the driver in the geofence at that same moment; (c) the in-geofence dwell of 429 s exceeds the 180 s minimum; (d) the driver ended the trip under RIDER_NO_SHOW once the dwell had run.

Your account, rider, is contradicted by your own device. The rider track places you between 884 m and 891 m from the pickup pin for the entire waiting window and never once inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius (0 qualifying rider fixes out of 62). Your chat message 'coming down now' was sent at 20:01:07 — more than two minutes after the driver messaged at 19:59:12 and after the free waiting period had already elapsed — and the driver still waited a further five minutes before cancelling. Because the rider-presence limb of POL-NS-04 affirmatively fails on admissible fixes, that clause does not exonerate you; and because the dwell exceeds the minimum, POL-NS-06 shows no waiting-period shortfall. The driver did not reinstate the clock early, so POL-NS-05 does not displace it.

The money. The fare ledger's cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 reconciles exactly with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect. Under POL-NS-07 the driver's payout is 80 percent of that SGD 4.50 net fee, being SGD 3.60, and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 (below 4) and 0 divided by 138 completed trips is 0.0 (not above 0.08). The emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and, per POL-GEN-03, amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60 — it is the amount this ruling moves, not a second payment and not a refund to you. Your SGD 4.50 charge stands as it presently is. The monetary effect of SGD 3.60 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically.

No referrals are made. POL-NS-05 does not find the arrival marker false (the driver was stationary at 0.0 kph at the arrival timestamp and inside the radius), so no false-arrival referral arises; and no POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged — neither profile shows any repeat-dispute or abuse pattern, no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on the deciding facts, and no deciding artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d), so the 0.70 confidence floor is comfortably cleared.

Discarded at the mechanical check: one claim from each advocate about the missing traffic advisory. Each cited EV-ADVIS-02701-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) without naming that issue code, as POL-GEN-02(1) requires, so the referee discarded them. The absent advisory does not change the outcome: the qualifying dwell here is a single continuous run and needs no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i).

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the record shows the driver arrived at the pickup pin (Blk 640 Jurong West St 61, STANDARD zone) at 19:58:47 and stayed put. His GPS trace places him within the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 19:58:47 to 20:05:56 — a continuous stationary run of 429 seconds carried by 44 qualifying fixes, at 0.0 kph — which is more than twice the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; no_show_threshold_sec is null). He terminated the trip at 20:06:00 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after that waiting period elapsed. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold, the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee stands, and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. The fare line reconciles: fare_breakdown cancellation_fee/total_charged = 4.50 equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd = 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. POL-NS-05 is not engaged — the driver was stationary at the pin (dwell start offset 0.0 s) when he tapped 'I'm Here', so the marker is not false and the waiting clock runs as recorded. POL-NS-06 gives no relief: the 429-second dwell exceeds the 180-second minimum, so there is no shortfall and no need to accumulate intervals across a traffic advisory. POL-NS-03 does not apply, as the stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius rather than outside it.

On the rider's account that he was 'only a few minutes late': it is not borne out.
